findings.title: AceHedge LLC, Fantize LLC, and StockText LLC were new significant customers introduced in fiscal year 2024 (period begin
findings.description: AceHedge LLC, Fantize LLC, and StockText LLC were new significant customers introduced in fiscal year 2024 (period beginning May 1, 2023) whose fees were structured to be cash-based. They were disclosed as exceeding the 10% revenue concentration threshold in the Q1 FY24 and Q2 FY24 timeline (three-month and six-month periods ended July 31, 2023 and October 31, 2023) but were not disclosed in any FY22 or FY23 annual filings, nor were they listed under the Note 13 equity-settled investment disclosures, indicating their fees were not settled in customer equity during these periods.

findings.title: Netcapital Inc. artificially inflated its reported revenue and net income by recognizing massive non-cash consulting fee
findings.description: Netcapital Inc. artificially inflated its reported revenue and net income by recognizing massive non-cash consulting fees settled in illiquid equity units of its own crowdfunding clients, using self-referenced and unverified portal listing prices to satisfy accounts receivable.
